title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Approving the Designation of Yuelu District People's Court, Tianxin District People's Court, and Changsha County People's Court of Changsha, Hunan Province to Have Jurisdiction over Certain Intellectual Property Disputes
keywords_en: jurisdiction; intellectual property; courts' jurisdiction over certain intellectual property disputes
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Reply on Approving the Designation of Yuelu District People's Court, Tianxin District People's Court, and Changsha County People's Court of Changsha City, Hunan Province to Have Jurisdiction over Certain Intellectual Property Dispute Cases

Fa [2019] No. 88

Hunan High People's Court:

We have received your Request on Applying for Restoring the Jurisdiction of Yuelu District People's Court, Tianxin District People's Court, and Changsha County People's Court of Changsha City over First-Instance Ordinary Intellectual Property Cases and Implementing Cross-Regional Jurisdiction (Xiang Gao Fa Bao [2019] No. 44). Upon study, the reply is as follows:

1. It is approved to designate the Yuelu District People's Court of Changsha City, Hunan Province to have jurisdiction over the following intellectual property cases: first-instance general intellectual property civil and administrative cases arising within the jurisdictions of Yuelu District, Wangcheng District, and Ningxiang City of Changsha City, Hunan Province, and first-instance intellectual property criminal cases.

2. It is approved to designate the Tianxin District People's Court of Changsha City, Hunan Province to have jurisdiction over the following intellectual property cases: first-instance general intellectual property civil and administrative cases arising within the jurisdictions of Tianxin District, Furong District, and Yuhua District of Changsha City, Hunan Province, and first-instance intellectual property criminal cases.

3. It is approved to designate the Changsha County People's Court of Changsha City, Hunan Province to have jurisdiction over the following intellectual property cases: first-instance general intellectual property civil and administrative cases arising within the jurisdictions of Changsha County, Kaifu District, and Liuyang City of Changsha City, Hunan Province, and first-instance intellectual property criminal cases.

4. It is approved to designate the Changsha Intellectual Property Tribunal to have jurisdiction over the following intellectual property cases: first-instance intellectual property civil and administrative cases arising within the jurisdiction of Hunan Province concerning patents, new plant varieties, integrated circuit layout designs, trade secrets, computer software, cases involving the recognition of well-known trademarks, and monopoly disputes; appeal cases against the judgments of first-instance general intellectual property civil and administrative cases heard by grassroots people's courts within the jurisdiction of Changsha City; and appeal cases against the judgments of first-instance intellectual property criminal cases heard by grassroots people's courts within the jurisdiction of Changsha City.

April 17, 2019
